free.question: Is Social Share Button free to use?
free.answer: Yes. It is open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0 and maintained by the AOSSIE community.

privacy.question: Does it track my visitors?
privacy.answer: No. The library never collects, stores or sends data. It only emits events inside the browser, and you decide whether to forward them to an analytics tool.

frameworks.question: Which frameworks does it work with?
frameworks.answer: Any. It is plain JavaScript, so it runs in plain HTML, React, Next.js, Preact, Vue, Angular, Qwik and more. The installation steps above have copy-paste code for the most common setups.

platforms.question: Can I choose which platforms appear?
platforms.answer: Yes. Pass the platforms option, for example platforms: ["linkedin", "twitter", "email"]. Available platforms are WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram, Reddit, Email, Pinterest and Discord.

styling.question: Can I match it to my brand?
styling.answer: Yes. Choose a light or dark theme, one of four button styles (default, primary, compact, icon-only), set buttonColor and buttonHoverColor, or add your own CSS class with customClass.

spa.question: Will the shared link update when my single-page app changes route?
spa.answer: Yes. When you do not pass a fixed url, the library listens for client-side navigation and updates the link automatically. You can also call updateOptions() yourself.

missing.question: The button does not appear. What should I check?
missing.answer: Make sure the stylesheet link is inside the page head, the script has loaded before you initialize, and the container selector matches your element. For example, container: "#share-button" needs an element with id="share-button".

npm.question: Can I install it from npm instead of a CDN?
npm.answer: Yes. Run npm install @aossie-org/social-share-button, then import the module and its stylesheet in your code.
